name: Emausaurus
sum: Emausaurus is an early armoured dinosaur from the Early Jurassic of northern Germany, known from a juvenile or subadult skeleton.
wsnote: Estimated for the juvenile holotype (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: SGWG 85, with the right side of the skull, right lower jaw, tail vertebrae, limb bones, ribs and armour — Toarcian clay pit near Grimmen, Germany.
biology: Probably semi-bipedal to quadrupedal and covered in osteoderms.
author: Haubold 1990
